name: ncclient
what_it_is: ncclient is a Python library that facilitates client-side scripting and application development around the NETCONF protocol. It provides a high-level API for connecting to and managing network devices via NETCONF over SSH.
components: manager — high-level connection and session manager
transport — SSH transport layer (Paramiko or ssh-python)
operations — NETCONF RPC operations (get, get_config, edit_config, etc.)
devices — vendor-specific device handlers (Juniper, Cisco, Huawei, etc.)
configuration: host, port, username, password or key-based auth passed to manager.connect()
hostkey_verify flag controls SSH host key verification
manager_params for timeout and other session settings
ssh_config support for reading OpenSSH config files
constraints: Requires a live NETCONF-capable device or server at connect time — no built-in mock server or simulator is included
Python 2.7 or Python 3.5+ required; Paramiko 1.7+ and lxml 3.3.0+ are mandatory runtime dependencies
SSH transport only — does not support NETCONF over TLS or SOAP transports
async keyword renamed to async_mode in 0.6.0; code using older API is incompatible with Python 3.7+
notable_absences: No docker-compose or containerized test environment in the repository
No built-in NETCONF server or device simulator — tests require real or third-party simulated devices
No YANG model validation or schema awareness built in
